IRON YARD v96 — single public update, 18 November 2026.

Deploy the game source verified at 94984f37f99121631a7bd8271f8c374a359a18f2 to the existing public experience: creator 9774173158, universe 10775909016, root place 99189039770065.

This release adds the server-timed reload bar and visible magazine count, open-center hit cues that scale with distance, simpler distant scenery effects, and positional impact sounds for metal, glass, concrete, wood and soil. Roblox confirmed the previous public place version was 91.

Use the existing exact-commit Rojo CI, public owner and destination checks and one-shot publisher.
